headline: A South African grandmother pleaded with an AI-made ghost in a TikTok prank her granddaughter played on her.

summary: Briefly News reports that a South African grandmother was tricked by her granddaughter with an AI ghost filter in a TikTok clip shared on 6 Oct 2026, and that she clasped her hands, pleaded with the ghost and told her granddaughter it was a Tokoloshe. The Tokoloshe is a creature from Zulu and Xhosa folklore that can be summoned by witches or enemies to cause harm, and the clip had 19.4K likes when the article was written.
